pricing.disclaimer: Pricing ranges are Chicago-area averages for planning. Your exact quote depends on design, size, materials, and permit requirements. Free detailed quote in one business day.

items.q: What is a channel letter sign?
items.a: A channel letter sign is a 3D illuminated sign where each letter is individually fabricated with aluminum sides and a translucent acrylic or polycarbonate face, lit internally by LEDs.

items.q: How much does a channel letter sign cost in Chicago?
items.a: Typical Chicago storefront projects range from $3,000 to $12,000. Larger building-mounted installations can reach $25,000 or more depending on size, materials, and permit complexity.

items.q: How long do channel letter signs last?
items.a: Well-built channel letters last 10 to 15 years. UL-listed LED modules are rated for 50,000+ hours of operation.

items.q: Do you handle sign permits for Chicago and the suburbs?
items.a: Yes. We file sign and electrical permits with the municipality ourselves. Typical permit turnaround is 2 to 4 weeks, running in parallel with fabrication.

Front-lit letters have a translucent face that glows outward — the most common storefront look. Halo-lit letters have a solid face and backlight the wall behind them, producing a soft outline glow. Halo-lit is more subtle and premium.

items.q: How long does design and installation take?
items.a: Standard projects go from approved design to mounted sign in 3 to 7 days. Complex or large builds take 2 to 3 weeks. Permit adds 2 to 4 weeks, typically running in parallel.

items.q: Can you match my exact brand colors?
items.a: Yes. We match Pantone, CMYK, or RAL codes on faces, vinyl overlays, and painted returns. Send your brand guide or a reference file with your quote request.

items.q: How bright are LED channel letters?
items.a: Storefront-readable from 100+ feet. We specify LED brightness based on your mounting height, ambient lighting, and street distance — so the sign is legible without being harsh.

items.q: Are your signs weather-rated for Chicago winters?
items.a: Yes. UL-listed LEDs rated for sub-zero temperatures, sealed housings, and weather-rated wiring. Our installs are designed for the full Midwest weather cycle.

items.q: Can I update the sign if I rebrand later?
items.a: Yes. Refacing is available — we can replace the letter faces without replacing the entire sign structure, which saves most of the original investment.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on LEDs and fabrication?
Do you ship outside the Chicago area?
items.a: Our primary service area is Chicago plus the NW suburbs. Fabrication-only shipping is possible for longer distances — contact us with your address and we'll confirm feasibility.
